info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Platform & Diagnostics
info.description:
Platform hardware, diagnostics, and system monitoring configuration for Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

**Modules covered:** alarm-profile, diagnostics, buffers, dying-gasp, geo (geographic location), gnss (GPS/GNSS), synce (Synchronous Ethernet), qfp-stats (QFP statistics), ida (Intelligent Digital Assistant), rmi-dad (RMI DAD), ethinternal-subslot, ucse (UCS-E blade), mmode (maintenance mode)

**YANG Augments:** Cisco-IOS-XE-switch, Cisco-IOS-XE-diagnostics, Cisco-IOS-XE-platform, Cisco-IOS-XE-geo, Cisco-IOS-XE-gnss, Cisco-IOS-XE-synce, Cisco-IOS-XE-ucse, Cisco-IOS-XE-mmode

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Platform & Diagnostics.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Platform & Diagnostics.yang)

get.description:
Retrieve alarm profile configuration for environmental and hardware monitoring thresholds.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section alarm-profile`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-switch (alarm-profile augment)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.
